en.summary: Alcohol poisoning can be life-threatening. NHS: emergency care if unconscious/hard to wake, seizures, slow/irregular breathing, cold/clammy/blue-tinged skin, or vomiting while not fully awake. Put in recovery position if unconscious and breathing; do not leave alone. Distinct from alcohol-withdrawal entry.
emergencyIf: Unconscious or hard to wake after drinking
Cold, clammy, pale or blue-tinged skin
selfCare: If conscious and advised to wait for help: keep warm, sit/lie safely, sip water if able — still seek urgent assessment when severe
doNot: Do not leave the person alone
Do not give more alcohol or coffee as a 'cure'
Do not put them in a cold shower
Do not invent detox drug regimens

fr.summary: L'intoxication alcoolique peut tuer. Urgences si inconscient, convulsions, respiration lente, peau froide/cyanose, vomissements sans éveil complet. PLS si inconscient et respire.

he.summary: הרעלת אלכוהול מסוכנת. חירום אם מחוסר הכרה, פרכוסים, נשימה איטית, עור קר/כחלחל, הקאות בלי ערנות. מצב החלמה אם נושם.

ru.summary: Алкогольное отравление опасно для жизни. Неотложка при бессознательном состоянии, судорогах, медленном дыхании, холодной/синюшной коже, рвоте без полного сознания. Положение восстановления если дышит.
